name: solidity-constant-product-exchange
title: Constant-product token exchange
description: Two-asset ERC20 AMM with LP shares, proportional liquidity, fee-retaining swaps and slippage bounds.
assumptions: One constant-product pool, no router or protocol fee. Permanently locked minimum LP shares. Deadline protection is left to the transaction sender; min-output/min-shares bounds handle execution price limits. Standard non-rebasing tokens only; direct donations alter reserves at the next operation.
